title: Quotations, bids and print layouts
summary: Quotes and bids got project amounts, a validity date, print layouts and a cleaner list.
details: Project amount shown on quotations, with aligned summary cards across the admin lists.
Print layouts for quotations and bids, including print size, header and footer, and table columns.
Rich text with bullets and tables inside quote and bid text.
Quote validation date and refreshed quotation list and buttons.
Layout work for bids and quotations, plus server-side clean-up of quotations.

title: Email inbox with Microsoft 365
summary: Read, reply to and send email from inside the system through Microsoft 365.
details: Microsoft 365 mailbox connection with an Outlook-style interface.
Signatures, header images and inline images in outgoing mail.
Attachments on received and sent mail, replies, and a protection against sending messages to trash by mistake.
Email notifications and an email icon with new-mail indicators.
Sales quotes and expenses can be shared by email.
Several fixes for email errors (including a server 500 error) and folder handling.

title: Takeoff workspace and Object Inspector
summary: Door takeoffs can be built and edited on screen, with an inspector for each opening.
details: Takeoff workspace for building door schedules.
Object Inspector with its own toolbar and buttons to edit an opening's details.
Fixes to saving and cancelling takeoff changes.

title: Internal chat for super administrators
summary: Super administrators can message each other with files and images, with sound alerts.
details: One-to-one chat between super administrators with image and document attachments.
Unread counter on the chat button and a chime when a message arrives.

title: AI assistant
summary: An AI assistant button was added to the app.
details: AI assistant integrated into the system.
Floating action buttons reorganised so chat, AI and form actions do not overlap.

title: Expenses
summary: Track expenses from the office or the field, including receipt photos from a phone.
details: Expenses list with add and update screens.
Mobile layout and photo capture for receipts.
Expenses can be shared by email.

title: Project control, organizations and certifications
summary: Super administrators get project control tools, and projects are organised by organization.
details: Project control screen and buttons for super administrators.
Projects grouped by organization, with a list view.
Home page certifications.
Administrative tool and a red flag on messages that need attention.

title: Interface polish, dark mode and dashboard charts
summary: Dark mode, skeleton loaders, a faster menu and dashboard graphics.
details: Dark mode.
Skeleton loaders and a please-wait indicator while pages load.
Sidebar and fast-menu changes, and clearer rows and columns in tables.
Action buttons stay reachable while scrolling.
Dashboard graphics.
UUID-based links across the system.

title: Maintenance and fixes
details: Email attachments working end to end.
A PHP patch and general fixes.

title: Employees, job titles and skill rates
summary: Employee records with job titles, skills and several rates per skill.
details: Employee form shows age, with job titles and other related lists chosen by typing and tapping + Add.
Each skill can carry several rates (for example three for Painter, four for Carpenter), including custom named rates.
Competent person certifications and a quality control flag on employees.
Access levels can be created straight from the employee form.

title: Work schedules with foreman, competent person and QC
summary: Plan each job with a foreman, crew and daily tasks, shown as cards.
details: Job is the first choice; the foreman is picked from employees and shown as a card.
Checkboxes say whether the foreman is the competent person and/or the quality control person; otherwise another person is chosen.
Available employees are grouped by foreman and show their job titles.
Daily tasks created once can be reused on any schedule.

title: Daily tasks and the foreman field checklist
summary: Foremen check their tasks when they start the day, from a phone, with photos.
details: Reusable task types that can require photos and quality control, with a nice confirmation before deleting.
Duplicate tasks are blocked for the same day.
Foremen record status, progress, notes and photos for each task, with a camera and gallery button.
Each task can be restricted to the foreman, competent person or quality control person.
The foreman can delegate a task to one or more people on the crew, or do it himself.
Super administrators see who has completed their tasks.

title: Employee access and My schedule
summary: Employees get a simple page with their jobs, addresses, foreman and tasks.
details: Employee level can reach the dashboard, profile and their own credentials but cannot manage levels.
My schedule shows the project, address, foreman and the tasks set for them.

title: Group chat
summary: Chat with more than one super administrator at once.
details: Start a group from the chat list or by adding someone to an existing one-to-one chat.
Add people later, or leave a group.
Unread counts and notifications work for groups.

title: System updates
summary: This page: a 30 day list of changes that super administrators can share with other user levels.
details: Super administrators choose which user levels can see each update and confirm before sharing.
Anyone allowed can open an update to read the detailed changes.
